name: Makai Fukkatsu
source: The story begins with the fact that one reporter Akira Kamishiro gets a call from a friend archaeologist - Professor Masunaga. As it turns out, with archaeological research has been stolen valuable artifact - "Divine Stone". At the same time in the nearby village disappears abbot of the local Buddhist temple. Trying to understand what happened, Kamishiro and Masunaga are involved in the chain of mystical events.
translation: 故事始于记者神城明接到考古学家好友增永教授打来的电话。考古调查中发现的贵重文物“神之石”遭人盗走；与此同时，附近村庄一座寺院的住持也离奇失踪。为弄清真相，神城与增永被卷入一连串神秘事件。
